# QR generator

`qrcode.js` is the unmodified browser distribution of `qrcode-generator` 2.0.4
by Kazuhiko Arase, obtained from the npm package of that exact version.

Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

It runs locally in the browser. Registration URLs are never sent to an external
QR image service. Its MIT copyright and license notice remain in the source.
